name: Attention-Grabbing Browser Tab Titles
author: Chetan Vaghela

sections.description:
Attention-Grabbing Tab Title helps re-engage visitors by automatically changing the browser tab title when they navigate away from your website.

When a visitor switches to another browser tab, the plugin cycles through custom messages that you define, making your website stand out among multiple open tabs. Once the visitor returns, the original page title is automatically restored.

The plugin is lightweight, easy to configure, and works with any WordPress website, including blogs, business websites, portfolios, and e-commerce stores.

Features

  • Enable or disable the browser tab title animation.
  • Add multiple custom titles to display in rotation.
  • Configure the time interval between title changes.
  • Automatically restore the original page title when the visitor returns.
  • Option to enable the feature only on the homepage.
  • Lightweight and easy to configure.
  • Works with most WordPress themes.

Use Cases

  • Bring visitors back to your website after they switch tabs.
  • Increase engagement on blogs and business websites.
  • Highlight promotions, offers, or important messages.
  • Improve user retention for e-commerce stores.
  • Draw attention without using intrusive popups.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tab Title Settings.
  4. Enable the feature and configure your custom tab titles.
  5. Save the settings.
sections.faq:
How do I configure the plugin?

Go to the plugin settings page under the ‘Tab Title Settings’ menu item. There, you can enable the feature, add title texts, set the title change interval, and choose if the feature should be enabled only on the homepage.

Will the original page title be restored?

Yes. The original browser tab title is automatically restored when the visitor returns to your website.

Can I display multiple tab titles?

Yes. You can add multiple custom titles that rotate at your chosen interval.

Can I enable it only for the homepage?

Yes. The plugin includes an option to enable the feature only on the homepage.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes. The plugin works with most WordPress themes because it modifies the browser tab title using JavaScript.
